_README: Gaana config. Fill in 'token' and (if needed) 'lavalink.nodes'. Nothing is hardcoded in the source code — every secret lives here or in environment variables.
_REQUIRED: token            -> Discord bot token (Developer Portal > Bot > Reset Token).
lavalink.nodes[] -> Your Lavalink v4 server: host, port, password, secure, id (any label).
_OPTIONAL: botName              -> Branding shown in embeds/footers. Default 'Gaana'.
embedColor           -> Hex accent colour for embeds. Default '#f1b2c1'.
maxVolume            -> Hard ceiling for the volume command. Default 150.
sourceChoice         -> Default source for plain-text searches: 'spotify' or 'youtube'. Users can switch it live from the Now Playing card buttons or with the 'source' command.
sources              -> Which link sources to hand to Lavalink by name (see below).
maxQueueSize         -> Refuse new tracks past this queue length. Default 1000.
stayInVoiceByDefault -> true = bot stays connected when the queue empties. Default false.
supportServerUrl     -> Invite shown in help/support links (optional).
voteUrl              -> Vote page shown by the vote command (optional).
registerSlashCommands -> true = register slash commands on startup. Default true.
slashGuildIds        -> Optional list of guild IDs to register slash commands in instantly.
developerIds         -> Discord user IDs allowed to run owner-only commands.
activityRotation     -> Text templates for the rotating status. {prefix}, {servers}, {bot}, {commands} are replaced.
presence             -> Defaults for the status/stream/activity commands (see below).
_SOURCES_NOTE: Each key below enables handing that link type to Lavalink by name. A source only actually works if your Lavalink node has the matching plugin (LavaSrc for spotify/applemusic/deezer/yandexmusic). If a source is unavailable, Gaana automatically falls back to a YouTube search built from the link, so the song still plays. Set a key to false to pass the raw link through instead.
_EMOJIS_NOTE: Optional. Override any icon with your own gradient/animated Discord emoji, e.g. "play": "<a:play:123456789012345678>". Set a key to "" to remove that icon. Leave the whole block empty to use the clean built-in glyphs. The 'spotify' and 'youtube' keys are the source-choice buttons on the Now Playing card — drop in your own brand emoji there (e.g. "spotify": "<:spotify:123456789012345678>").
